item.title: ECHL: Thunder extend win streak; thrash Atlanta
item.description: ATLANTA, Ga. – Tyler Brennan made 36 saves as the Adirondack Thunder extended their win streak to five games with a 5-2 victory over the Atlanta Gladiators on Saturday night in front of 7,917 at Gas South Arena. Adirondack took an early lead as Brannon McManus set up Tag Bertuzzi, and he sent a backhand shot by goaltender Ethan Haider for the 1-0 lead. item.title: Summer home: New York City Ballet celebrates 60 years at SPAC
item.description: SARATOGA SPRINGS, N.Y. — The New York City Ballet (NYCB) will be back for another summer in the Spa City, returning for its annual residency at the Saratoga Performing Arts Center (SPAC) from July 8-11 as part of the venue’s celebratory 60th anniversary season.
